## Installing

- **Most people should install from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ermay12.transmit).** It updates automatically, and it's the only way to get the free week and plans.
- **This APK** is for phones without Google Play. It works with your own AI API key only (Settings → Advanced). It's signed with a different key than the Play version, so the two can't update each other: uninstall one before installing the other. Transmit needs Android 12 or later and Google Messages on your phone.
